title: The hospices in the hospice case, as the State licence listing names them
question: Under what licensee and trade names do the hospices of the Bay Area hospice case hold their State licences, and which other agencies share their licensee or building?
finding: 5 of the 5 case hospices looked up are in the State listing. The licensee of "Physicians Hospice Group" (4625 1st St, Suite 230, Pleasanton) is A Plus Prime Care Hospice, Inc, which settles the name-and-address link that earlier screens could only suggest. Home Connect Hospice, LLC is licensed as Valor Hospice; Attaie Healthcare, Inc. runs Sunbright Hospice Care and, next door (Suite B), Sunbright Home Health Care; a sister company, Home Connect Home Health, LLC, holds a Fremont home-health licence. 3 of the listed hospices show no federal certification number in the listing.
how: The State health department's licence listing (data date 16 October 2026), found by HCAI facility number. Sister agencies: other hospice and home-health licences with the same licensee name, or at the same street address (suite ignored) with a different licensee.
limits: A trade name that differs from the licensee is common and permitted. Hospice and home-health agencies of one company often share an office. The listing shows open facilities only, so a closed or surrendered licence is not visible, and it gives no owners or managing employees (the federal ownership file does). A missing federal number may mean the agency bills Medicare under a number the listing does not carry.
